revisionNote: Full fresh snapshot 2026-10-01 of the AA models leaderboard and coding-agents page, replacing round4 for aa_intelligence_index and aa_coding_agent_index, plus the first full aa_terminal_bench_4 snapshot from the same models payload (terminalBench40). extraction.mappingRule: round4 slug/host mapping kept as-is; new entries are exact name matches listed in mappingAdditions. Near names stay unmapped (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next≠qwen3.8-flash, Hy3-preview≠hy3, GLM-5-Turbo≠glm-5).
